scaled_pdb_tokenization_cameo.description: Protein backbone structure tokenization on the scaled CAMEO held-out split. Reference values use the paper's lowest-resolution GEOBPE setting from Table 16.

rmsd.description: Primary geometric reconstruction error between original and reconstructed backbone coordinates.

lddt.description: Local distance preservation score that rewards reconstructed backbones with native-like local geometry.

bpr.description: Encoded-token bits-per-residue proxy that penalizes inefficient structural encodings.

vocab_size.description: Vocabulary compactness constraint that discourages memorizing structures with an unbounded token set.
